name: PurpleDelta multi-operator fraudulent-employment clusters

attribution.legal_posture: Recorded Future/Insikt Group research attribution for aggregate multi-operator activity; official identity finding, charge, conviction, sanctions designation, and adjudication status remain unresolved.

ttps: remote access to facilitator-maintained employer devices
caveats: This record retains no civil identity, current controller, precise location, active account, victim, identity document, image or raw selector.
Potential proprietary-information collection is an analytic possibility; observed exfiltration remains unconfirmed.
PurpleDelta is Recorded Future's analytic designation and is kept separate from PurpleBravo unless a source explicitly bridges a particular cluster.
The 22 fabricated personas remain an aggregate count; the report assigns aggregate treatment only.

statements: Recorded Future reports at least 22 fabricated personas across several multi-operator clusters, not 22 verified natural people.
One cluster submitted applications to more than 1,100 organizations, sometimes at a reported rate of at least 60 per day.
The source assesses that ten or more organizations probably or certainly employed operators.

Operators used compartmentalized browser profiles, calendars, spreadsheets, AI assistants, generated or face-swapped profile images, transcription, recording, remote access, and facilitator-maintained devices.
Observed video sessions showed multiple real people, so the cluster must not be collapsed into one operator.
